text: Why would you want a brahmin? Do you have a caravan? Well, it doesn't matter. I only take care of them. Dan is the one that owns them; he won't sell them though.
source_text: Why would you want a brahmin? Do you have a caravan? Well, it doesn't matter. I only take care of them. Dan is the one that owns them; he won't sell them though.

text: 你为什么想要双头牛？你有货车吗？算了，这都无所谓。我只是看牛的。丹才是主人；不过他是不会卖的。
source_text: 你为什么想要双头牛？你有货车吗？算了，这都无所谓。我只是看牛的。丹才是主人；不过他是不会卖的。

text: Cuz of all the missing caravans. He doesn't have any to spare, the caravans use most of them. The others are sold for food. Well, I better stop talking; Dan will get mad if he sees me talking to a stranger.
source_text: Cuz of all the missing caravans. He doesn't have any to spare, the caravans use most of them. The others are sold for food. Well, I better stop talking; Dan will get mad if he sees me talking to a stranger.

text: 是因为那些失踪的商队。他没多少可卖了，大部分被商队用了。其余的卖了换了粮食。算了，我还是不说了；要是丹看到我和陌生人说话，他会气疯的。
source_text: 是因为那些失踪的商队。他没多少可卖了，大部分被商队用了。其余的卖了换了粮食。算了，我还是不说了；要是丹看到我和陌生人说话，他会气疯的。

text: Nothing . . . I mean, I'm taking care of the brahmin.
source_text: Nothing . . . I mean, I'm taking care of the brahmin.

text: 没什么……我是说，我在照看双头牛。
source_text: 没什么……我是说，我在照看双头牛。

text: What's the spear for? Are they dangerous?
source_text: What's the spear for? Are they dangerous?

text: 这根矛是用来干什么的？它们很危险吗？
source_text: 这根矛是用来干什么的？它们很危险吗？

text: What's a brahmin? You must be joking. Why they're one of the major food sources and forms of transportation around here. They haul the caravans. Dan says this is a really important job, but it's the Bone.
source_text: What's a brahmin? You must be joking. Why they're one of the major food sources and forms of transportation around here. They haul the caravans. Dan says this is a really important job, but it's the Bone.

text: 双头牛是什么？你在开玩笑吧。我们吃喝运货就靠它。它们还能拖货车。丹说这是真正重要的工作，不过没什么油水。
source_text: 双头牛是什么？你在开玩笑吧。我们吃喝运货就靠它。它们还能拖货车。丹说这是真正重要的工作，不过没什么油水。

text: Dan's right. You are doing a great job.
source_text: Dan's right. You are doing a great job.

text: 丹说得对。你是在做一件重要的工作。
source_text: 丹说得对。你是在做一件重要的工作。

text: Yea, it looks that way. Have fun.
source_text: Yea, it looks that way. Have fun.

text: 是啊，看来是这样。玩得开心点。
source_text: 是啊，看来是这样。玩得开心点。

text: Hey, you're one of those skags aren't you?
source_text: Hey, you're one of those skags aren't you?

text: 嘿，你是那些蠢货里的一个，是不是？
source_text: 嘿，你是那些蠢货里的一个，是不是？

text: Really? You think so? Gee, thanks.
source_text: Really? You think so? Gee, thanks.

text: You're not from around here, are you? I'll give you one tip: Don't get caught stealing!
source_text: You're not from around here, are you? I'll give you one tip: Don't get caught stealing!

text: 你不是这里的人，是吧？我会给你一条忠告：别因为偷东西被逮住了！
source_text: 你不是这里的人，是吧？我会给你一条忠告：别因为偷东西被逮住了！

text: I wouldn't dream of stealing. Stealing is wrong.
source_text: I wouldn't dream of stealing. Stealing is wrong.

text: 我做梦都不会想到去偷东西。偷东西是不好的。
source_text: 我做梦都不会想到去偷东西。偷东西是不好的。

text: Yea, I think I'm starting to agree with you. This job isn't so bad, really. It makes me feel good for some reason. Well, I've got to go before I get in trouble.
source_text: Yea, I think I'm starting to agree with you. This job isn't so bad, really. It makes me feel good for some reason. Well, I've got to go before I get in trouble.

text: 是的，我想我开始同意你的看法了。这份工作其实也不是那么糟。它在有些地方让我觉得很好。好了，在我有麻烦之前，我得走了。
source_text: 是的，我想我开始同意你的看法了。这份工作其实也不是那么糟。它在有些地方让我觉得很好。好了，在我有麻烦之前，我得走了。

text: Please don't hurt me or my brahmin.
source_text: Please don't hurt me or my brahmin.

text: Hey what are you trying to do?  I don't have anything you'd want.
source_text: Hey what are you trying to do?  I don't have anything you'd want.

text: 嘿，你想干什么？我没有你想要的东西。
source_text: 嘿，你想干什么？我没有你想要的东西。

text: Dangerous? No, not really. They can give you a really nasty bite, but they're pretty cool. They fart and burp a lot. I don't know why.
source_text: Dangerous? No, not really. They can give you a really nasty bite, but they're pretty cool. They fart and burp a lot. I don't know why.

text: 危险？不，其实没什么危险。它们会给你来上一大口，不过它们挺酷的，经常又放屁又打嗝，我也不知道为什么。
source_text: 危险？不，其实没什么危险。它们会给你来上一大口，不过它们挺酷的，经常又放屁又打嗝，我也不知道为什么。

text: Oh, they can be awfully stubborn when I want them to do something.  I just gently stick them to get them to move around . . .  plus I don't want to get too close; they sometimes kick.
source_text: Oh, they can be awfully stubborn when I want them to do something.  I just gently stick them to get them to move around . . .  plus I don't want to get too close; they sometimes kick.

text: 喔，我要它们去做什么的时候，它们犟得要死。我只好轻轻地打着它们走……另外我也不想靠它们太近了，它们有时会踢人。
source_text: 喔，我要它们去做什么的时候，它们犟得要死。我只好轻轻地打着它们走……另外我也不想靠它们太近了，它们有时会踢人。

text: Please don't talk to me. Dan is going to yell at me again.  He really gets pissed -  I mean - mad, when I'm not paying attention to what I'm doing.
source_text: Please don't talk to me. Dan is going to yell at me again.  He really gets pissed -  I mean - mad, when I'm not paying attention to what I'm doing.

text: 请你不要和我说话了。丹又要吼我了。我不专心干活的话，他会很愤怒–我是说-狂怒。
source_text: 请你不要和我说话了。丹又要吼我了。我不专心干活的话，他会很愤怒–我是说-狂怒。

text: He's just trying to help. Work hard and I'm sure he'll be nicer.
source_text: He's just trying to help. Work hard and I'm sure he'll be nicer.

text: 他只是想帮忙。努力工作后我想他会更好的。
source_text: 他只是想帮忙。努力工作后我想他会更好的。

text: Here kid, take 50 bucks and get away from this jerk.
source_text: Here kid, take 50 bucks and get away from this jerk.

text: 这里，孩子，拿上50个瓶盖，离开这个笨蛋。
source_text: 这里，孩子，拿上50个瓶盖，离开这个笨蛋。

text: Please don't, I'm already in enough trouble.
source_text: Please don't, I'm already in enough trouble.

text: 请别这样，我已经有大麻烦了。
source_text: 请别这样，我已经有大麻烦了。

text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. He's just trying to help you.
source_text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. He's just trying to help you.

text: 对不起，我不是那个意思。他只是想帮你。
source_text: 对不起，我不是那个意思。他只是想帮你。

text: No you aren't, you lazy little skeev!
source_text: No you aren't, you lazy little skeev!

text: Yea, maybe you're right . . . actually, he seems pretty cool, but I wish he wouldn't yell at me so much.
source_text: Yea, maybe you're right . . . actually, he seems pretty cool, but I wish he wouldn't yell at me so much.

text: 是的，也许你是对的……实际上，他看起来很酷，但我希望他不要动不动就朝我吼叫。
source_text: 是的，也许你是对的……实际上，他看起来很酷，但我希望他不要动不动就朝我吼叫。

text: WOW! I can live on this for the rest of my life! Thanks a lot, mister!
